headline: Big Walk's AI use sparks backlash from Independent Games Festival jurors
summary: Independent Games Festival jurors published a statement saying they would not vote for games using generative AI in any capacity, after the developer of indie hit Big Walk said it used AI sparingly late in development to help fix a bug, sparking a reckoning in the indie gaming community.

claims.statement: Some IGF jurors said they would not vote for games that use generative AI in any capacity.

sources.quote: Some Independent Games Festival (IGF) jurors published a statement yesterday saying they would not vote for games that use generative AI in "any capacity."
Any amount of AI coding is too much for many Independent Games Festival judges.

claims.statement: Big Walk's developer said the game used AI sparingly in the final stretch of development, including to fix a bug.

sources.quote: the developer of indie hit Big Walk has published a statement saying it "sparingly" used AI in the "final stretch" of the game's development
Big Walk used AI to fix a bug. Now the indie gaming world is having a reckoning.
